Strategy: Avoid dead residual space. A leftover in (0, item) is too small for another item of this size, so it is wasted, while a leftover of at least item stays usable and an exact fit wastes nothing. Score bins by leftover with a penalty inside the dead band, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin preserving usable space. It may help by saving usable space, but may fail by spreading items when leftovers would fit items.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - (item if r - item > 0 and r - item < item else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Dead-band residual penalty: leftover in (0, item) penalized by item; exact fit or leftover >= item unpenalized (Best Fit otherwise).
